title: Cognitive Load Diagnosis
description: AIL 606 textbook section connecting cognitive load diagnosis to cognitive load diagnosis table with intrinsic/extraneous/germane load evidence, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.

learning_objectives.statement: Decompose a single difficulty into intrinsic, extraneous, and germane components
Estimate element interactivity for a named learner and tie it to a revision
Document a bounded AI/software support move with accepted and rejected suggestions
Use annotations, support requests, and revision notes to decide what help or design change should come next

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
